Tamil Nadu Pongal gift scheme includes redesigned sarees and dhotis

The Tamil Nadu government's Pongal gift scheme will provide redesigned sarees and dhotis to nearly 2.23 crore ration cardholders. This annual scheme aims to distribute essential clothing items as part of the Pongal festival celebrations. The redesigned nature of the garments is a new feature for this year's distribution.
